title: 1Password vs Fathom
description: 1Password and Fathom serve different purposes: 1Password focuses on password and credential management, while Fathom is associated with analytics or meeting-related software depending on the product intended. They are not direct substitutes; confirm the exact Fathom product before comparing.
verdict: There is no meaningful universal winner between products in different categories. Evaluate 1Password for credential management and secure access sharing. First confirm which Fathom product this page refers to, then assess it against its own analytics or meeting-workflow requirements. Do not rely on cross-category star ratings to make a purchase decision.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 1Password and Fathom?
faqs.answer: 1Password focuses on password and credential management. The name Fathom is used by products in different software contexts, so confirm the exact vendor and product represented on this page before evaluating its capabilities.

faqs.question: Can 1Password replace Fathom?
faqs.answer: No. Credential management and analytics or meeting workflows are different jobs. Select a product based on the task and requirements it is meant to support.

faqs.question: Which has better value, 1Password or Fathom?
faqs.answer: For 1Password, test credential storage, secure sharing, access policies, and administration. For Fathom, first verify the exact product, then test the workflows, data handling, integrations, and controls relevant to that product.
